title: DogTag CDC import form credential v1
description: recordType == CDC_IMPORT_FORM. Mirrors the CDC_IMPORT_FORM branch of packages/dogtag-standard-ts/src/schema.ts's validateSchema, plus the cdcPath == "standard" cross-cutting microchip rule (see the if/then below and specs/schemas/README.md - schema.ts enforces that rule for ANY record type, but this registry structurally encodes it only here, the one record type it is documented against).

ageMonthsAtEntry.description: A bare JSON number, not a canonical Integer-tagged string - schema.ts checks typeof === 'number' here, unlike every leaf-commitment-layer Integer field. type:number here also rejects a string-typed value the same way schema.ts's typeof check does, so this one constraint covers both violation shapes schema.ts can produce for this field.

cdcPath.description: Optional. schema.ts's needsChip flag is also set (independent of recordType) whenever cdcPath == "standard" anywhere in the codebase; this registry expresses that consequence structurally only for this record type via the if/then below.

credentialSubject.description: microchip is optional here UNLESS cdcPath == "standard" (see the if/then below, which additionally requires it in that case). Declared here too, unconditionally, purely so its shape is still validated on the rare credential that carries a microchip without cdcPath == "standard".
